'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Michael Richards DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Richards]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Drop & drain & say OMG WTF. Barve → [[Bane Malar]]. Location X3 → [[Location, Location, Location (V)]]. Lieutenant Lenz (V) → [[Lobot (V)]] (uncertain). Sheet Sundown + Sundownstown → 2× [[Sundown]] (may redlink). Sandland Wastes → [[Tatooine: Jawa Camp]]. Line 30 Darth Maul struck. Line 2 Mara Jade (V) / Saber (V) counted as character + [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]].
